title: alchemilla glaberrima subsp. major
intro: Alchemilla glaberrima subsp. major, commonly known as Lady's mantle, is a plant species belonging to the family Rosaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include promoting digestion and reducing inflammation. The health benefits of Alchemilla glaberrima subsp. major are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which help to soothe digestive issues and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
